## 6. Lean MVP Scope (<30-Day Build)
`### 30-day MVP for AI-Powered Micro Change Order Generator
1. Capture the workflow described by: Freelancers and agencies lose significant revenue to undocumented scope creep from informal client requests, and full PSA suites are too bloated.
2. Show one automated result the buyer can check without a sales call.
3. Charge a self-serve monthly price and skip enterprise onboarding.

Non-goals: no hardware build, no two-sided marketplace, and no custom mobile app.`
